notes: There is a Frosted glass widget now, and it is the first in the list. A translucent panel that lets the wallpaper through, with dark type on it, so it sits on a photo as well as it sits on a plain wall.

It has a Frost dial — a slider in Settings → Widget, 0 to 100, that decides how much milk is in the glass. Left is thin and clear and the wallpaper tints the panel; right is a soft, nearly solid pane. It stays where you leave it.

The preview in Settings shows the glass over a strip of colour, so the dial has something to act on, and the panel behind it blurs the way real glass does. Drag the slider and the preview moves with your finger; let go and the widget on your home screen takes the same setting.
The preset carries its own blue accent for the playing bars and the fine-tune swatches still work on top of it — pick a background there and it keeps its colour, and simply gains the glass.
Every other preset is untouched: the eighteen that were there draw exactly what they drew in 80.5.2, and the Frost dial is hidden unless you are on the glass one.
